packageRules.description: bosa/opendata-best-webapi is the BeSt Address register: the image IS the dataset, tagged YYYY-WW for the ISO week of the address extract (2026-35, 2026-36, ...). Renovate's default docker versioning reads 2026-35 as major 2026 with compatibility suffix 35, and would then only ever look for another -35 tag, so the weekly address-data refresh would silently never be offered. The character class is [0-9] rather than a backslash-d escape so the rule needs no JSON escaping and cannot be broken by a stray backslash.

KrakenD 3.x refuses the configuration ghcr.io/optimce/swagger2krakend generates ("unsupported version: 3 (want: 4)"), so a 3.x bump would leave the gateway unable to start and every /api route down. Hold the 2.x line until a swagger2krakend release emits version 4, then remove this rule in the same change that moves the pin. Checked 2026-10-07 against 3.0.0.

eclipse-mosquitto is pinned to the 2.1 line because %u substitution in dynamic-security ACLs only exists from 2.1.0 (devices could publish nowhere on 2.0). Only the -alpine tags exist on that line. Allow patch and minor updates on 2.x; a 3.0 bump changes per_listener_settings and must be a deliberate migration.
